# The Storm-Ready Home

> A 486-page American disaster-preparedness manual by Paul Raymond: 130 numbered protections, 23 hazard playbooks, a 60-day preparation sequence, and a printable family binder. Digital book (PDF), $9.99, 7-day money-back guarantee, sold via Gumroad. Companion to The Warning Hour, Paul Raymond's documentary channel on American storms.

The site is the sales page for the book, plus free resources: written dispatches for each episode of The Warning Hour (Field Notes), printable preparedness checklists, a storm-preparedness guide for every US state and DC, and a free state-specific preparedness packet.

## Pages

- [Home / the book](https://paulraymond.online/): what the book covers, who wrote it, sample pages, FAQ, and purchase.
- [Buy the book](https://paulraymond.gumroad.com/l/ebook): $9.99 checkout, instant PDF delivery.
- [Free state packet](https://paulraymond.gumroad.com/l/packet): one state-specific preparedness packet, free.
- [About Paul Raymond](https://paulraymond.online/about/): the method — primary documents only, every figure cited, honest limits stated.
- [Field Notes](https://paulraymond.online/field-notes/): written dispatches from The Warning Hour episodes.
- [Joplin Tornado 2011](https://paulraymond.online/field-notes/joplin-tornado-2011/): why 24 minutes of warning wasn't enough — Episode 1 dispatch with the full video.
- [Tornado Warning vs. Watch](https://paulraymond.online/field-notes/tornado-warning-vs-watch/): the NWS definitions, what each asks of you, and the siren myths.
- [Free Storm Checklists](https://paulraymond.online/resources/): seven storm checklists, free to read; printable pack by email.
- [Family Emergency Plan Template](https://paulraymond.online/resources/family-emergency-plan-template/)
- [Tornado Safe Room Guide](https://paulraymond.online/resources/tornado-safe-room/)
- [Go Bag Checklist](https://paulraymond.online/resources/go-bag-checklist/)
- [Emergency Binder](https://paulraymond.online/resources/emergency-binder/)
- [Hurricane Preparedness Checklist](https://paulraymond.online/resources/hurricane-preparedness-checklist/)
- [Tornado Preparedness Checklist](https://paulraymond.online/resources/tornado-preparedness-checklist/)
- [Home Inventory for Insurance](https://paulraymond.online/resources/home-inventory-for-insurance/)
- [State Storm Guides](https://paulraymond.online/states/): shelter rebates and grants, emergency agencies, insurance regulators, and the top hazards for all 50 states and DC.
- [The Warning Hour on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@PaulRaymond-s9v): the documentary channel behind the book.
- [Terms & disclaimer](https://paulraymond.online/terms.html): refund policy, informational-purposes disclaimer, liability.
- [Privacy policy](https://paulraymond.online/privacy.html): what data is collected and how it is used.

## Facts

- Author: Paul Raymond. Book: The Storm-Ready Home, 486 pages, PDF.
- Price: $9.99 one-time. Refunds: 7 days, no questions asked.
- Built from National Weather Service and FEMA post-storm reports; figures cited to their issuing documents.
- The checklists and state guides are free to read without purchase; the printable pack and per-state packets are delivered by email (free Gumroad products).
- Not medical, legal, engineering, financial, or insurance advice.
